Both lists present; alternatives exist in the library
Chip, word, line anatomy named and drawn
Chip on Farrowing, pen list and Home; Word on Farrowing's Go-to-pen map; Line on the pen list; Dot removed
States table per variant; none-states give reasons

One chip per row; urgency order stated

variants.name: Chip
findings: Map holds: Active blue, Done green, Sow died red, Overdue red, To do muted; every chip says its word
Home's overdue card says it twice: chip 'Overdue' and meta 'Batch 28 · farrowing window · 2 days overdue', which truncates to '2 days ov...'

variants.name: Word
findings: B1 'Active' blue and B4 'Overdue' red render from status({variant:'word'}); by-hand pen colours gone. Done cell is a hand check glyph + '23 born'

variants.name: Line
findings: Farrowing no longer hand-writes line markup: overdue is a chip plus row text 'Due 3 days ago'

findings.text: Home's overdue task card states overdue twice (chip 'Overdue' + meta '2 days overdue'), and the repeat pushes the meta into an ellipsis ('2 days ov...') (astra-home-task-card.js:22-24).
findings.fix: For state 'overdue', make the meta timing the count only ('2 days') or drop it; the chip already says Overdue.

findings.text: Farrowing's Go-to-pen Done cell draws its own check glyph instead of the Status done mark.
findings.fix: Render it with status({ variant: 'word', kind: 'done', text: f.text }) like Active and Overdue, or leave the count plain without the hand glyph.
